title: Employees excluded from the layoff list
prompt: Return the name (column: name) of every employee whose id does NOT appear in the layoffs table, using a NOT IN subquery.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'Grace Lee','Sales'),(2,'Marcus Bell','Engineering'),(3,'Nina Torres','Sales'),(4,'Omar Reyes','Support'),(5,'Priya Nair','Engineering'),(6,'Quinn Adams','Support'); CREATE TABLE layoffs (employee_id INTEGER); INSERT INTO layoffs VALUES (1),(4);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT employee_id FROM layoffs);
